title: The Daily Sum Paid for Loss of Use on a Vehicle Already Earning Less
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan was already carrying a defect before the loss, the daily sum its plan publishes for loss of use is paid at a share of itself, the vehicle having been earning at less than its full rate before the loss.

- Where a defect stands recorded on the vehicle in the six months before the appraisal and two or more claims have been opened on the enrolment in the twelve months before, the plan's daily sum is paid at the marketplace's impaired-earning share of 60 percent.
- Where a defect stands recorded in that period and fewer than two claims have been opened on the enrolment in the twelve months before, it is paid at the marketplace's part-earning share of 80 percent.
- Where no defect stands recorded in that period, the plan's daily sum is paid in full.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures)

On a plan publishing a daily sum of 65, the three readings give 39, 52 and 65 a day respectively.

| Defect in the six months before | Claims opened in the twelve months before | Daily sum paid at |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | 60 percent |
| yes | fewer than 2 | 80 percent |
| no | any | the whole of it |

### The records behind the reading

Defects recorded on the vehicle are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle, within the six months before the appraisal. The claims counted are those opened on this enrolment within the twelve months before.
